reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited text supports the preferred position: Section 2(a) (p0022/p0024) expressly confirms Client is not obligated to use the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize competing systems, subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and Section 10 confidentiality — i.e., no non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds Customer.

The only 'Non-Competition Agreement' reference (p0054) constrains TrueLink's licensed use of Credit Data, a restriction on the counterparty, which the rule expressly treats as acceptable; the rationale correctly notes it is a separate instrument whose terms should be confirmed, without over-flagging.

Deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes, consistent with the compliant classification; rationale is accurate and appropriately retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
